LESSON: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM 18 2.0. MATTER 2.1. MIXTURES 14 2.2. WATER POLLUTION 

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.3: The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution . Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What makes up the human breathing system?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main parts of the human breathing system. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  in the examples.
2. Explain The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
4. Show that you can: identify the main parts of the human breathing system

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw the human breathing system and label the main parts,
2. Discuss symptoms and prevention of common conditions and diseases that affect the human breathing system and share,
3. Creativity and Imagination: The learner reflects on appropriate images as they design different ways of modelling the human breathing system using locally available material.
4. Digital literacy: The learner acquires digital manipulative skills as they use simulations or digital images to illustrate major parts of the human breathing system. Values:
5. Love: The learner develop caring attitude towards self and others’ health as they discuss symptoms and prevention of common conditions and diseases that affect the human breathing system.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes up the human breathing system?
2. What enhances a healthy breathing system?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
